linkedin:
Only 23% of the 4,441 remote jobs on Loker Dollar reveal their pay. The other 77% keep compensation private. That is a choice, not a signal.

What the data shows:
- 1,000 of 4,441 listings (23%) include a salary or hourly figure; the remaining 3,441 (77%) do not.
- 2,753 listings (62%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world.
- Communication leads skills demand at 39% (1,662 of 4,282 analysed), followed by AI at 12% (517).
- 1,560 distinct companies are hiring remote, but of the five highlighted (Neo Financial, TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, Jobgether), only Neo Financial discloses pay at $5 USD/hour.

The lesson for job seekers: a missing salary does not mean a low offer. Many employers expect candidates to negotiate.

Filter for "worldwide remote" on the board and apply before listings close. Full breakdown here:
https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
